what: Error hint uses equals-form flag syntax but the planned parser only accepts a separate value
scenario_or_breakage: The containment error tells callers to use --allow-findings-outside-tmpdir=true, and following that hint would hit unknown option instead of enabling the bypass
suggested_fix: Either change the hint/docs/tests to the accepted space form --allow-findings-outside-tmpdir true or add parser support and regression coverage for --allow-findings-outside-tmpdir=true

what: The plan validates the new boolean after the containment branch that already consumes it
scenario_or_breakage: An invalid value with an outside-tmpdir findings file reports the containment error instead of the planned must be true or false error, so the invalid-flag edge case is not actually guaranteed
suggested_fix: Validate ALLOW_FINDINGS_OUTSIDE_TMPDIR before the containment case while leaving existing sibling validation order unchanged, and add an invalid-value test that uses an outside path

what: Outside-tmpdir success can now reach an unguarded mv -f to a less-controlled destination
scenario_or_breakage: If the outside ballot or parent directory is not writable, set -e can make aggregate-findings.sh exit nonzero after dispatch, violating the non-fatal aggregator contract and review-core expectations
suggested_fix: Plan preflight or guarded handling for final rewrite failures, set MERGE_PIPELINE_RC=2 with a warning, preserve input, and add a read-only outside-destination regression

what: The plan explicitly skips SECURITY.md despite relaxing a filesystem containment trust boundary
scenario_or_breakage: The new opt-in allows reading and rewriting a regular file outside review tmpdir, which is security-relevant under the repo instruction to update SECURITY.md for such behavior changes
suggested_fix: Add a SECURITY.md trust-model note covering the opt-in flag, retained symlink/output containment, outside ballot prompt exposure, and in-place clobber semantics

what: The planned allow-path test reuses the merge stub but does not require matching input reviewer slots
scenario_or_breakage: The merge stub emits cursor-a, cursor-b, and cursor-c reviewers; a generic 2-block outside fixture can fail validator checks for unknown or missing reviewers instead of proving outside containment relaxation
suggested_fix: Specify the outside fixture to include cursor-a-output.txt, cursor-b-output.txt, and cursor-c-output.txt across its two FINDING blocks, or add a dedicated two-reviewer stub merge

what: The planned sibling TMP_OUTSIDE directory is not covered by the existing cleanup trap
scenario_or_breakage: Repeated harness runs leave temp directories behind outside $TMP
suggested_fix: Create the outside directory under $TMP or extend the EXIT trap to remove TMP_OUTSIDE as well
